# lila

Lila scripting API.

```
import lila
loc = lila.locator("Target")          # object API (lila.nodes)
loc.translate_y = 10
lila.ops.parent("Target", "Rig")     # every command, also as bare names in the script editor
```

## Progress

```python
Progress(title: str, total: float = 0.0, cancellable: bool = False, background: bool = False) -> None
```

Progress of a long script, shown like a scene load: with lila.Progress("Baking", total=n) as p: p.step(). background=True shows it as a small indicator instead, for work on a worker thread (lila.tasks).

### Progress.step

```python
step(n: float = 1.0) -> None
```

Advance by n units.

### Progress.set_status

```python
set_status(text: str) -> None
```

### Progress.cancelled

```python
cancelled: bool
```

Read only.

True once the user pressed Cancel.

## build_id

```python
build_id()
```

The exact build: commit time (UTC) and sha, "-dirty" with uncommitted changes: "202610281430-9641744ab1".

## error

```python
error(message)
```

Writes an error to the log without raising; raise an exception to stop the script.

## info

```python
info(message)
```

Writes an info line to the log and the script editor output.

## undo_chunk

```python
undo_chunk(name='chunk')
```

Groups every edit made inside into one undo step. Chunks nest; only the outermost becomes a step.

```
with lila.undo_chunk("Build arm"):

...
```

@lila.undo_chunk("Build arm") def build_arm(): ...
